title: ITR-3 Part A-BS, Part A-P&L and Part A-OI (Books of account) - data
description: The balance sheet, profit and loss account and other information, in the ITR-3 form's own structure. Each line carries the form's item number so a filled tab reads across to the utility without translation.

books_maintained.description: Part A-GEN: whether books are maintained under section 44AA. If false, only the no-accounts case section 61 of Part A-P&L applies.

balance_sheet.description: Part A-BS as at the last day of the year.

profit_and_loss.description: Part A-P&L. Trading account, then the profit and loss account proper.

depreciation_in_books.description: 11 - book depreciation. Income-tax depreciation is computed separately on the Depreciation tab and the difference is an adjustment in Schedule BP.

no_accounts_case.description: Part A-P&L item 61, where books are not maintained.

speculative.description: Intraday equity is a speculative business and its result is kept separate all the way through: speculative losses set off only against speculative income.

expenses.description: The total of the charges where the statement itself states one. Leave it out when it does not: the charges[] rows are summed in code.

charges.description: Every charge on this business, one row per head exactly as the statement names it: brokerage, exchange transaction charges, STT, stamp duty, SEBI fees, GST, clearing charges. Do NOT add them up — code does that. A broker's realised profit is usually stated GROSS of these, and they are deductible business expenses, so leaving them out overstates the income.

head.description: The statement's own name for the charge.

note.description: Anything doubtful about it: whether it is already netted off the profit, or whether it belongs to another business.

derivatives.description: F&O is a non-speculative business. Turnover here decides whether section 44AB audit applies.

other_information.description: Part A-OI: the adjustments that carry into Schedule BP.

disallowance_40a.description: OI 8 - amounts disallowed for want of TDS

disallowance_40A3.description: OI 9 - cash payments over the limit

other_expenses_of_business.description: Business expenses that belong to no single segment: depository (DP) charges, annual maintenance, pledge charges, platform subscriptions, interest on money borrowed for the business.

head.description: The statement's own name for the charge.

note.description: Anything doubtful about it: whether it is already netted off the profit, or whether it belongs to another business.

assets_acquired.description: Capital items found on the invoices: a laptop, a monitor, a phone, a desk. These are not expenses -- relief comes through depreciation under section 32 -- so they are reported here instead of in other_expenses_of_business, and the depreciation itself is computed, not stated.

description.description: The item as the invoice names it.

invoice_date.description: ISO date on the invoice. It may fall in an earlier previous year; report it as it is.

put_to_use_on.description: ISO date the asset was first used for the business, if the documents say. Leave null and the invoice date is used.

source.description: The invoice file this came from.
